pages.title: Flying Ships to Space
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() An Aeronautics ship can reach Northstar worlds with a **Dimensional Drive** or **Stellar Navigator**, no rocket needed.
- Both are built with a Stellar Core.
- Propellers and burners need air, and the Moon and Mercury have none: plan thrusters.

Two bridge mods let an Aeronautics ship cross to Northstar worlds without a rocket: the Dimensional Drive and the Stellar Navigator. Dimensional Sable lets [#](7A3C9A)[Sable](entry://glossary/sub_level)[#]() ships change dimension at all.

pages.title: Dimensional Drive
pages.text: Place on a ship. Right-click to choose a Northstar destination, arm it, then fly up to the trigger altitude to launch.

pages.title: Recipe here
pages.text: In this pack the Dimensional Drive costs a [#](2E5AAC)[Stellar Core](entry://stars/stellar_core)[#](), 4 Titanium Ingots and 4 [#](2E5AAC)[Precision Mechanisms](entry://create_basics/brass_and_assembly)[#](). Press R over it in [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() to check. It offers the Moon, Mars, Venus, Mercury, Earth and Earth Orbit.

pages.title: Using it
pages.text:
The drive must sit on an Aeronautics ship.

- Set the target planet and trigger altitude in blocks, then **Arm** and **Confirm**.
- Some destinations need an **Interplanetary Navigator** on board.
- [#](2E5AAC)[Goggles](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() show destination, speed and altitude.

pages.title: Stellar Navigator
pages.text: From Northstar Aeronautics Compat. Brings an Aeronautics vessel to another planet. It can be turned off in [#](7A3C9A)[config](entry://glossary/config)[#]().
Needs a Stellar Core and a bucket of [#](2E5AAC)[Levitite Blend](entry://flight/balloons_and_lift)[#]().

pages.title: Gravity and air
pages.text:
Ships that arrive take on the world's gravity and air. The Moon and Mercury have no air, Mars has almost none, and Venus is crushingly dense.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** propellers and burners need air, so plan [#](2E5AAC)[thrusters](entry://flight/propulsion)[#](). See [#](2E5AAC)[Propellers](entry://flight/propellers)[#]().
